phase_2_real_pty_operator_experience.regression_note: Full suite before and after the repair: 12 failed, 1722 passed, 7 skipped — identical, so the shell rewrite introduced no regressions. Those 12 failures are pre-existing (see OBS-02).
root_causes_repaired: HunterShell.run() read with input(), which is line buffered, so '/' was not delivered until Enter. Replaced with a raw-mode keystroke reader that hands over to the palette the instant '/' starts a line.
_KeyReader.read_key() did a blocking read(2) after ESC, so a lone Escape hung until two more bytes arrived. Replaced with select-based disambiguation and an os.read bypass of text-layer buffering.
Handing over to the palette by leaving and re-entering raw mode discarded keystrokes already queued behind the '/'. The palette loop now runs on the same active reader.

_run_selected_command collapsed DispatchResult to an exit code, discarding exit_requested, so choosing /Exit from the palette printed its farewell and returned to the prompt instead of exiting. The whole palette chain now returns DispatchResult.

observed_pre_existing_defects.how_observed: A real `Create-New-Search --targets 5 --mode new` run froze SEARCH-20260801T171834Z-07D2F753 (HIP2, HIP1444, HIP57866, HIP5938, HIP6748) reporting prior_search_count=0 for every target, while the resolved-action preview simultaneously reported 'Cross-project history freshness: absent: data_selection/hunter_prior_search_history_v1.json'.
observed_pre_existing_defects.invalid_artifact: results/searches/SEARCH-20260801T171834Z-07D2F753 was frozen under the defective path. DUR-02 forbids regenerating a frozen manifest, so it is retained unmodified and must not be treated as evidence of verified novelty.
observed_pre_existing_defects.residual_limitation: The gate reads this repository's own published export path. Consuming sibling exports through sibling_history_export_path() is not yet wired into New eligibility; with no sibling checked out the path correctly fails closed, so no unverified novelty claim can be made.
observed_pre_existing_defects.resolution: hunter_search.cross_project_history_validity() derives export validity from the per-source states that load_cross_project_history_export stamps (there is no top-level field), degrading the whole export to its weakest source. _require_decision_grade_history() raises SearchLifecycleError unless the state is in CROSS_PROJECT_DECISION_STATES. Selected targets now persist cross_project_history_validity and cross_project_history_source (IDENT-04). check_identity_and_history now asserts the selection path consumes the decision states. Regressions in tests/test_hunter_new_eligibility_fails_closed.py.
observed_pre_existing_defects.summary: New eligibility did not consume cross-project history at all. _select_new_targets read only the local priority queue, hardcoded prior_search_provenance=[], and carried a selection_reason asserting each target was 'not previously searched by this project' — a novelty claim it never verified.
observed_pre_existing_defects.why_the_gate_missed_it: check_identity_and_history only grepped hunter_cross_project_history.py for the five validity-state string literals. The vocabulary existed and CROSS_PROJECT_DECISION_STATES was defined, but hunter_search.py referenced validity_state only for cadence, never for cross-project history. A vocabulary check cannot detect unwired machinery.

observed_pre_existing_defects.consequence: schema_version cannot distinguish old from new records, which is exactly what DUR-01's 'versioned schemas' requirement exists to prevent. Frozen manifests cannot be retro-filled (DUR-02), so the check now asserts the most recent manifest per mode, which is what DUR-03 actually requires of the current pipeline.
observed_pre_existing_defects.next_action: Bump to hunter_search_manifest_v4 the next time a manifest field is added, and record the field set per version.
observed_pre_existing_defects.summary: Provenance fields were added to hunter_search_manifest_v3 in place without bumping the schema version, so v3 manifests from July lack prior_search_count, prior_search_provenance_summary, cross_project_prior_search and priority_config_version while later v3 manifests carry them.
